3210.name: The Stable Entrance
3210.description: A wide cobblestone road leads south from the bustling streets of Garathorm toward a large wooden stable complex. The scent of hay and horses fills the air. A weathered sign reads 'Garathorm Royal Stables - Finest Mounts in the Realm'. Hoofprints and wheel ruts mark the well-traveled path.

north.description: To the north lies On The King's Road Outside The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies The Royal Stable.

203602.name: A Large Stall

east.description: To the east lies The Royal Stable.

203602.description:
This is the largest stall in the Royal Stables, fit for a king's
warhorse, with room enough for a destrier to turn and lie down. The
walls are panelled in dark oak carved with a frieze of galloping horses,
and the manger is of hammered copper. A brass plaque on the gate bears
the royal crest of Garathorm. The gate to the east opens onto the main
aisle near the stable doors.

extra_descs.brass plaque crest:
The plaque shows a crowned tower above crossed lances, the arms of the
royal house of Garathorm. Beneath it, in small engraved letters, runs
the line: For the King's own mount, and no other.

203603.name: The Royal Stable

north.description: To the north lies The Stable Entrance.

south.description: To the south lies The Royal Stable.

west.description: To the west lies A Large Stall.

203603.description:
The great doors to the north open on the cobbled road toward the city,
letting a wedge of daylight into the barn. A swept aisle of packed earth
runs on south between oak partitions, each post rubbed smooth by
generations of shoulders and flanks. Through a wide gate to the west
lies the largest stall in the building. Hay dust drifts in the light,
and the warm smell of horse is everywhere.

203604.name: A Stall

east.description: To the east lies The Royal Stable.

203604.description:
A tall, airy stall, this one has a window shuttered against the draught
and a hayrack of iron bars fixed high on the wall. The partition boards
are scored with tooth marks where a bored horse has cribbed at them.
Horse brasses hang in a neat, gleaming row from a nail by the window. To
the east the gate of the stall leads out into the main aisle.

203605.name: The Royal Stable

north.description: To the north lies The Royal Stable.

east.description: To the east lies A Stall.

south.description: To the south lies The Royal Stable.

west.description: To the west lies A Stall.

203605.description:
Here the aisle widens between two matching stalls, one through a half-
door to the east and one to the west, each with a brass nameplate
polished to a shine. Lanterns hang from iron hooks on the rafters, unlit
by day, and a water trough of hollowed stone stands against a post. The
aisle carries on north toward the stable doors and south deeper into the
building. Straw crunches underfoot, swept into neat ridges along the
walls.

203606.name: A Stall

west.description: To the west lies The Royal Stable.

203606.description:
This roomy box stall smells of clean straw and saddle soap. Its walls
are of thick planking, scarred low down where impatient hooves have
kicked them, and a manger of woven willow hangs at chest height in one
corner. A small barred window high up lets in a slant of grey light. The
half-door to the west opens back onto the aisle of the Royal Stable.

203607.name: A Stall

east.description: To the east lies The Royal Stable.

203607.description:
This stall is one of the plainer ones, its planking rough and its manger
a simple wooden trough. Fresh straw lies deep on the floor, and a water
bucket hangs in an iron ring by the gate. Someone has chalked a horse's
name on the post, half rubbed out, so that only three letters remain.
The gate east opens back onto the aisle of the Royal Stable.

203608.name: The Royal Stable

north.description: To the north lies The Royal Stable.

east.description: To the east lies A Stall.

south.description: To the south lies A Small Room.

west.description: To the west lies A Stall.

203608.description:
The aisle ends here before a narrow door to the south, where the grooms
keep a small room of their own. Stalls open to the east and west, their
gates hung with leather halters on iron nails. A wheelbarrow stands
upended against a post, its handles worn pale. The way north runs back
up the aisle toward the brighter end of the stable.

203609.name: A Stall

west.description: To the west lies The Royal Stable.

down.description: To the down lies In A Dusty Tunnel.

203609.description:
Something is wrong with this stall. The straw has been raked aside to
bare a square trapdoor of old, iron-strapped boards set into the floor,
and a cool breath rises through its cracks smelling of dust rather than
horse. The partitions here are older than the rest, darker and grooved
with strange marks near the floor. The gate to the west leads back into
the Royal Stable, and the trapdoor opens on a ladder going down.

203610.name: A Small Room

north.description: To the north lies The Royal Stable.

up.description: To the up lies A Small Loft.

203610.description:
The small room of the grooms is snug and plain: two narrow cots under
coarse blankets, a bench, and a row of pegs hung with patched coats and
leather aprons. A shelf by the door is stained with liniment and lamp
oil. A ladder against the back wall climbs up through a hatch into a
loft, and the door north opens on the stable aisle. The room smells of
horse sweat and woodsmoke.

203611.name: A Small Loft

down.description: To the down lies A Small Room.

203611.description:
Under the steep roof of the stables, this small loft is packed with
sweet hay stacked in loose bales to the rafters. Light needles through
gaps in the shingles, and old swallows' nests cling to the beams. The
floor creaks at every step, and a square hatch with a ladder leads down
to the grooms' room below. It is warm and drowsy up here, and the smell
of summer grass is everywhere.

203612.name: In A Dusty Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies In A Dusty Tunnel.

up.description: To the up lies A Stall.

203612.description:
A rough ladder climbs up through a square of faint light to the stall
above, and below it a cramped tunnel has been hacked from packed earth
and soft rock. Dust lies thick on every surface, rising in slow clouds
with each step and tasting of chalk. Old timber props hold up the low
ceiling, bowed under their load. The tunnel slopes away south into
blackness.

203613.name: In A Dusty Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies In A Dusty Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies In An Endless Tunnel.

203613.description:
The tunnel narrows until your shoulders brush raw rock on either side.
Dust has drifted against the stone in soft grey banks, unmarked except
by a few long, dragging furrows that lead on south. The air is stale and
close, and no sound carries from the stables now. North, the passage
climbs gently back toward the ladder.

203614.name: In An Endless Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies In A Dusty Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies In A Tunnel.

203614.description:
The passage runs straight and level into the dark, so long and so alike
that it seems to have no end at all. Every few paces the same chipped
rock, the same fallen pebbles and the same choking dust repeat
themselves, and the eye begins to doubt it is moving. Somewhere ahead a
faint draught stirs, the only promise that the tunnel goes anywhere. The
way back north is just as featureless, and the way south no different.

203615.name: In A Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies In An Endless Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies Tunnel Entrance.

203615.description:
At last the endless passage gives way to a broader tunnel where the rock
turns damp and dark. Water seeps from a crack in the ceiling and has
worn a shallow channel in the floor, and the dust here has become a grey
paste. A musky, animal stink drifts up from the south, where the tunnel
opens out. North, the long straight passage waits.

203616.name: A Small Room

east.description: To the east lies A Dim Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies A Monster's Lair.

203616.description:
Once a priest's chamber, this small room keeps only the bones of its
furniture: a cot frame with its ropes rotted away, a cracked washbasin
on a stone shelf, a niche where a lamp once burned. Scratches and gouges
mar the floor near the doorway to the south, where a reeking passage
drops toward something's den. The door to the east leads back into the
dim hallway. Plaster flakes from the ceiling in long pale curls.

203617.name: A Dim Hallway

east.description: To the east lies Tunnel Entrance.

south.description: To the south lies A Monster's Lair.

west.description: To the west lies A Small Room.

203617.description:
This forgotten hallway of the old temple is lit only by a grey glow
seeping from nowhere in particular. Carved panels along the walls have
been clawed and defaced, the saints on them scratched to blank stone. To
the east the hallway meets the broken tunnel mouth, and a small room
opens to the west. A wide, filthy archway to the south breathes out a
hot, rank stench.

203618.name: Tunnel Entrance

north.description: To the north lies In A Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Dim Hallway.

203618.description:
The tunnel ends here at a rough mouth where dug earth meets dressed
stone, as though diggers from below broke through into some older
building. Fallen blocks lie heaped to one side, and the gap in the
masonry is just wide enough to pass. To the west a dim hallway runs away
under a low vault, while the tunnel climbs north into the dust.
Splinters of old bone are ground into the dirt of the rock floor.

203619.name: A Monster's Lair

south.description: To the south lies An Underground Path.

203619.description:
A second den opens here, larger than any badger's set and twice as foul.
The earth has been dug out in a great bowl and lined with stolen straw,
horse blankets and torn sacking, all of it matted and stinking. Long
claw marks score the clay above the nest. A worn trail through the mess
leads south, where the earth slopes downward into a path beneath the
ground.

203620.name: A Monster's Lair

south.description: To the south lies In A Small, Dirty Place.

203620.description:
The rank smell is overwhelming in this low, round den scooped out of the
earth. Bones crack underfoot, mixed with matted fur, rotten straw
dragged down from the stables and the rusted rings of old harness. The
rock overhead is blackened with soot and greasy where something large
has rubbed against it. The only way on is a crawl south, deeper into the
filth, for the archway behind is lost in shadow beyond a fall of earth.

203621.name: An Underground Path

north.description: To the north lies A Monster's Lair.

east.description: To the east lies In A Small, Dirty Place.

south.description: To the south lies On A Path Before A Temple.

203621.description:
A path worn smooth by heavy feet winds through the earth here, its clay
sides shored up in places with stolen planks. To the north it climbs
into the reek of a den, and to the east it squeezes into a small, filthy
hollow. South, the path rises toward a faint glow of lamplight and the
familiar scent of hay. Roots thread the low roof, and dry soil sifts
down at every footfall.

203622.name: In A Small, Dirty Place

north.description: To the north lies A Monster's Lair.

east.description: To the east lies In A Disgusting Place.

203622.description:
This cramped hollow beneath the roots is choked with refuse: rags,
gnawed hide and black muck that clings to boots. Pale roots hang from
the earthen roof like the fingers of some buried hand, and drips fall
from them in a slow patter. A crawlway leads north to the lair, and to
the east the hollow opens into a place that smells worse still.

203623.name: In A Disgusting Place

north.description: To the north lies Tunnel Entrance.

west.description: To the west lies In A Small, Dirty Place.

203623.description:
The stench here is enough to make the eyes water, for this is where the
lair's owner leaves what it cannot eat. Heaps of rotting refuse rise
against the damp earth, sour with mould, and the ground is a slick of
filth. A narrow, sloping gap climbs north toward the tunnel mouth and
the dressed stone of the temple. To the west the hollow shrinks to a
small, dirty nook.

3211.name: On A Path Before A Temple
3211.description: You stand in the main hall of the Royal Stables. Sturdy wooden stalls line both sides of the wide central aisle. The sweet smell of fresh hay mingles with the warm scent of horses. Saddles, bridles, and riding gear hang from pegs along the walls. The stable master oversees all business from a small desk near the entrance. A passage to the east leads to the premium stables, while the training paddock lies to the south.

north.description: To the north lies An Underground Path.

south.description: To the south lies The Golden Arches Of Judgement.

203625.name: The Golden Arches Of Judgement

north.description: To the north lies On A Path Before A Temple.

south.description: To the south lies A Magnificent Entrance Hall.

203625.description:
Three tall arches of gilded stone rise from a tangle of ivy and young
saplings, their gold leaf peeling but still bright where the sun strikes
it. Words are carved across the keystone of the central arch, half
hidden by moss. Beyond them, to the south, broad steps lead up into a
magnificent entrance hall, while a grassy path runs back north toward
the temple path and the stables. Birds nest in the cracks of the stone.

extra_descs.keystone words arch inscription:
The carving is in an old temple script, worn shallow by rain: Pass with
a clean heart, for all who pass are weighed. Someone has scratched a
crude horse's head beneath it.

203626.name: A Magnificent Entrance Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Golden Arches Of Judgement.

south.description: To the south lies Behind The Huge Wooden Gate.

203626.description:
Even forgotten, this entrance hall is magnificent. Pillars of veined
marble climb to a ribbed ceiling painted with faded stars, and a mosaic
floor of suns and scales stretches between them, dulled by a grey skin
of dust. Tall doors stand open to the north on the golden arches and the
daylight. To the south a huge wooden gate, bound in bronze, stands ajar.

203627.name: A Hallway Corner

north.description: To the north lies A guard room.

east.description: To the east lies Behind The Huge Wooden Gate.

south.description: To the south lies A Hallway Corridor.

203627.description:
At this corner the hallway from the weed-choked court to the east turns
sharply south. A stout door to the north bears a painted shield, its
device peeled to a few flakes of red and gold, marking the room where
the temple guards once stood their watch. The plaster here is pocked
with gouges, as if blades once struck it in earnest. The corridor south
runs on into shadow.

203628.name: Behind The Huge Wooden Gate

north.description: To the north lies A Magnificent Entrance Hall.

east.description: To the east lies A Gallery Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies A Hallway Corner.

203628.description:
Behind the huge wooden gate lies a square court open to the sky, paved
in pale flags heaved up by weeds. Rain has streaked the surrounding
walls with green, and a dry fountain basin sits in the middle, its
bronze spout crusted with age. Covered hallways lead away to the east,
where paintings line the walls, and to the west, where the passage turns
a corner. The gate itself looms to the north, its timbers bleached grey.

203629.name: A Gallery Hallway

south.description: To the south lies A Wide Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Behind The Huge Wooden Gate.

203629.description:
Portraits in heavy frames line this long gallery, priests and patrons of
the old temple staring down through cracked varnish. Several canvases
have been slashed, and one hangs by a single cord, tilted as if in mid-
fall. The gallery opens west into the weed-grown court behind the gate,
and turns south into a wider hallway. Your footsteps echo strangely, as
if someone walks a pace behind.

203631.name: A Wide Hallway

north.description: To the north lies A Gallery Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies The Hallway Where It Turns.

south.description: To the south lies A Dirty, Narrow Corridor.

203631.description:
The hallway broadens here to the width of a cart, its walls hung with
moth-eaten tapestries of pilgrims on a winding road. Iron brackets that
once held torches line both sides, empty now and furred with rust. The
gallery lies north, the hall runs on east toward a bend, and a mean,
narrow corridor branches off to the south. A cold draught pushes past
from somewhere ahead.

203632.name: The Hallway Where It Turns

south.description: To the south lies A Hallway Intersection.

west.description: To the west lies A Wide Hallway.

203632.description:
The hallway turns sharply here, bending from the west and running away
south. A cracked stone bench is set into the corner, carved with the
worn figure of a kneeling monk. Dust has gathered thick against the base
of the walls, but a narrow trail through it shows that something still
passes this way. High above, a slot window lets in a thin, grey light.

203633.name: A Hallway Corridor

north.description: To the north lies A Hallway Corner.

south.description: To the south lies At A Hallway Turn.

down.description: To the down lies In An Obscure Dungeon.

203633.description:
This corridor runs between bare walls from a corner in the north to a
turn in the south. Halfway along, an iron grate has been levered out of
the floor and lies askew, and below it worn steps descend into a
darkness that smells of rust and old fear. Scratches cover the stone
around the opening. The lamps of the corridor have long since burned
out.

3212.name: Behind The Altar
3212.description: These stalls are larger and better-appointed than the common ones. Brass nameplates mark each stall, and the bedding is fresh and deep. War horses stamp impatiently in their reinforced stalls, while more exotic mounts peer from behind enchanted barriers. A sign lists the available mounts and their prices.

west.description: To the west lies A Hallway Corridor.

203635.name: A Dirty, Narrow Corridor

north.description: To the north lies A Wide Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies A Narrow Turn In The Corridor.

203635.description:
This corridor is barely wider than a man and filthy with grime, as if
servants once hurried along it out of sight of the priests. Grease and
soot coat the walls to shoulder height, and shards of broken crockery
crunch in the dust. North it widens into the main hallway, and to the
south it squeezes on toward a turn.

203636.name: A Hallway Intersection

north.description: To the north lies The Hallway Where It Turns.

east.description: To the east lies Another Hallway Corner.

west.description: To the west lies Another Hallway Corner.

203636.description:
Three hallways meet at this intersection beneath a small dome painted
with a great, faded eye. Water has stained the plaster below it in long
brown tears. The passage north returns toward the bend, and hallways run
off east and west, each to a corner of its own. An empty plinth stands
where the ways meet, its statue long gone.

extra_descs.dome eye painting:
The painted eye is wide open and ringed in flaking gold, its pupil a
disc of dark blue. From anywhere beneath the dome it seems to be looking
straight at you.

203637.name: Another Hallway Corner

south.description: To the south lies In A Long Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies A Hallway Intersection.

203637.description:
At this corner the hall turns from the west to run on south, and the
stonework changes, older and roughly dressed. A row of hooks along one
wall still holds the rotted scraps of grey robes. Somewhere beyond the
stone a slow drip keeps time. The air smells of tallow and damp.

203638.name: In An Obscure Dungeon

south.description: To the south lies A Holding Cell.

up.description: To the up lies A Hallway Corridor.

down.description: To the down lies In An Obscure Dungeon.

203638.description:
The steps from the corridor above end in an obscure dungeon of low
vaults and sweating stone. Chains hang from rings in the walls, and a
gutter along the floor runs with dark, foul water. The vaults repeat so
alike that it is hard to be sure where you are, and a stair that seems
to lead further down only brings you back here. A row of barred doors
lines the way south toward a holding cell.

3213.name: Before The Grand Altar

north.description: To the north lies Behind The Altar.

south.description: To the south lies An Entrance Hall.

3213.description:
The grand altar stands at the heart of the old temple, a single block of
white stone carved with sheaves of wheat and running horses. A great
round opening in the roof lets the sky in, and a pool of daylight falls
across the altar and the worn steps before it. A deep, untroubled calm
fills the chamber, as though nothing ill can follow you here. A narrow
door to the north leads behind the altar, and the entrance hall lies to
the south.

203640.name: A Narrow Turn In The Corridor

north.description: To the north lies A Dirty, Narrow Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies In A Hole.

203640.description:
The narrow corridor kinks here, turning from the north toward the east.
The wall at the turn has been broken through, its stones pulled out and
stacked untidily, and beyond the gap to the east the dark opens into raw
earth. A cold, earthy smell drifts out of the hole. The servants'
passage back north is as filthy as ever.

203641.name: In A Hole

west.description: To the west lies A Narrow Turn In The Corridor.

203641.description:
This is a hole dug out behind the temple wall, a pit of raw clay and
stones scarcely tall enough to stand in. The earth is scored with tool
marks and with something else, longer and deeper, like claws. Roots
dangle from the soil overhead, and a few fallen stones lie where they
tumbled from the broken masonry. The gap back west leads into the narrow
corridor.

203642.name: At A Hallway Turn

north.description: To the north lies A Hallway Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies Another Hallway Corner.

203642.description:
The corridor from the north turns east here, around a buttress of heavy
stone. Someone has chalked marks on the buttress, arrows and tallies, as
if counting days or counting the dead. A cracked water jar sits wedged
into the angle of the wall. Faint light glimmers from the hallway to the
east.

203643.name: Another Hallway Corner

east.description: To the east lies A Hallway Intersection.

west.description: To the west lies At A Hallway Turn.

203643.description:
This corner of the temple's halls is cramped and low, the ceiling
sagging where a beam has cracked. Rubble lies along one wall, swept
aside rather than cleared away. The hall runs east toward the painted
dome of the intersection and west to a turn by a stone buttress. A smell
of mildew and old candle grease hangs in the still air.

203644.name: In A Long Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Another Hallway Corner.

south.description: To the south lies A Hallway Corner.

203644.description:
This long hallway runs straight between walls of plain grey stone,
unadorned save for a carved line of small suns at shoulder height. The
floor dips in the middle, worn by countless processions. At its south
end a heavy oak door with an iron ring closes the way, and to the north
the hall reaches back to a corner. It is very quiet, the kind of quiet
that makes a traveller listen harder.

203645.name: A Holding Cell

north.description: To the north lies In An Obscure Dungeon.

203645.description:
This holding cell is barely long enough to lie down in. Iron bars front
it to the north, their lock long broken, and the floor is a bed of
mouldering straw. Tally marks crowd the stone in their hundreds, and one
corner has been scraped bare by fingernails. The air is cold and smells
of misery.

203646.name: An Entrance Hall

north.description: To the north lies Before The Grand Altar.

east.description: To the east lies A Small Treasury.

south.description: To the south lies A Hallway Ending.

203646.description:
This small entrance hall was built to impress those approaching the
grand altar. Its walls are faced with green marble, and a pair of stone
braziers, cold and grey with old ash, flank the tall door to the north.
A low, iron-bound door to the east is marked with a key carved into its
lintel. The silver-inlaid doors to the south lead back to the end of the
hallway.

203647.name: A Small Treasury

west.description: To the west lies An Entrance Hall.

203647.description:
Behind its iron-bound door the small treasury of the temple is a stone
vault no bigger than a pantry. Carved niches cover the walls, empty now,
each once meant for a reliquary or an offering box. A heavy chest,
bolted to the floor, gapes open with its lid hacked through. The door to
the west leads back into the entrance hall.

203648.name: A Hallway Ending

north.description: To the north lies An Entrance Hall.

east.description: To the east lies A Hallway Intersection.

203648.description:
The hallway ends here against a wall of carved stone showing a great
altar wreathed in flame. A tall double door of dark wood stands to the
north, its panels inlaid with tarnished silver. The passage leads back
east to the intersection. Incense, faint and very old, still clings to
the stone.

203649.name: A Hallway Intersection

east.description: To the east lies A Hallway Corner.

west.description: To the west lies A Hallway Ending.

203649.description:
Two passages once crossed here, but now there is only a straight way,
east to a corner and west to the hallway's end, for the side passages
have been bricked up with newer, rougher masonry. The mortar of the
bricked arches is cracked, and a cold breath leaks through. Above, a
painted frieze of robed figures marches toward the west, as if toward
something worth seeing. The flagstones are cleaner here, swept or
scuffed by passing feet.

203650.name: A Hallway Corner

north.description: To the north lies In A Long Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies A Hallway Intersection.

203650.description:
Beyond the oak door the hallway bends at this corner, turning off to the
west. A small shrine is cut into the angle of the walls, a niche holding
a stub of candle wax and a chipped clay offering bowl, both grey with
dust. The heavy door to the north leads back into the long hallway.
Fingers of old soot reach up the wall above the niche.

203652.name: A guard room

south.description: To the south lies A Hallway Corner.

203652.description:
The temple guards kept their watch in this square, plain room. A long
trestle table and two benches stand in the middle, and an empty weapon
rack lines one wall, its pegs snapped. A small hearth in the corner
holds only grey dust and a blackened log. The door to the south opens
onto the hallway corner.

3203.name: the stable master
3203.long_desc: Brynn the Stable Master stands here, sizing up potential riders.
3203.description: A stout, weathered man with calloused hands and a knowing look. Brynn has spent his entire life around horses and exotic mounts. He can tell a rider's skill at a glance.

talk_responses.default: Brynn says, 'Looking for a mount? Type STABLE LIST to see what we have, or STABLE BUY <mount> to purchase one.'
talk_responses.horse: Brynn says, 'A fine choice! Our riding horses are 2,000 gold. Reliable and swift.'
talk_responses.warhorse: Brynn says, 'War horses are trained for battle — 5,000 gold. They won't throw you when swords clash!'
talk_responses.nightmare: Brynn lowers his voice, 'Nightmares... those aren't for sale. Earn the Dark Brotherhood's trust, and they might gift you one.'
talk_responses.griffin: Brynn whistles, 'Griffins are wild and proud. I've heard they nest in Shadowspire. Slay the right beast and one might bond to you.'
talk_responses.clockwork: Brynn scratches his head, 'Clockwork Steeds? Those come from the Clockwork Foundry. Never need feeding, those mechanical beasts.'
